summary: Browse your notes by folder, tag, link, and backlink.
page_description: Keep a searchable copy of your note library ready to read on your Kobo.
release_notes: Rebuilt on a renderer that keeps every control reachable at the largest text sizes, and on a keyboard that can type every character this app asks for.
user: Somebody who keeps their notes in plain text.
job: Read your notes by folder, tag, link and backlink, away from your desk.
offline: The notes you push to the reader stay on it; it never touches the network.

data.kind: the notes you pushed, with their index
data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not needed; the originals stay on your computer

non_goals: It does not edit your notes.
It does not sync them back on its own.
